integrity: Proof is analytical and uniform in n; exact finite tests are supplementary. No external or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only categorical squares of unweighted complete graphs with equal factor order n>=3 are classified. No assertion about rectangular products, minimal target dimension, or arbitrary edge weights. Historical priority remains qualified by limited access to older complementary-l1 literature.
title: Sharp \(\ell_1\) distortion and regular-cut rigidity for \(K_n\times K_n\)
